authority: This candidate catalog is the normative semantic contract proposed for every locked composition path. Generated coverage may select current invariant IDs but may not redefine effects, boundaries, exclusions, identity authority, evidence, tests, or delegation.

structuralExclusionClasses.active-path-contract: The invariant is in this path's independently pinned active set and remains subject to the path's exact boundary contract.
structuralExclusionClasses.foreign-owner: This path cannot author a field or fact owned by an unreachable resource owner; the named path boundary rejects any forged foreign-owned value.
structuralExclusionClasses.same-owner-stage-or-fact-class: This path is inactive for this same-owner fact class: source, request, and native inputs cannot author builder/member/conformance/observed/runtime facts or other later-stage facts absent from the independently pinned active set.
structuralExclusionClasses.immutable-artifact-fact: A lifecycle, caller, provider, or downstream path cannot rewrite immutable Artifact facts or mint builder, member, support, provenance, semantic-identity, or conformance facts.
structuralExclusionClasses.hard-contract-nonwidening: The path may be relevant to this invariant but has no authority to weaken, replace, or mint the protected hard/common contract fact; the final shared validator rejects the attempted bypass.

phaseAuthorityPolicy.boundaryInput: shift only invariants complete before ingress to the pinned ingress-complete authority; otherwise preserve the invariant first-sound phase, deadline, and authoritative hook while retaining the ingress continuation chain
phaseAuthorityPolicy.otherNoAuthority: use the exact phase and component of the contract template rejectedForeignOwnerAt boundary; this is the path-relative complete structural exclusion authority

authoring.structuralExclusion: Foreign-owned resource fields are absent from the Artifact authoring contract.

artifact-normalization.structuralExclusion: Profile expansion cannot author a foreign-owned resource.

frontend-boundary.structuralExclusion: Frontend claims are untrusted and cannot bypass strict decoding, complete Artifact semantic replay, identity comparison, or Nix-handle validation.

raw-wire.structuralExclusion: Raw wire values have no source-level authority and are accepted only after strict decoding, complete Artifact semantic replay, identity comparison, and Nix-handle validation.

schema-migration.structuralExclusion: Migration cannot invent fields or authority absent from the source schema and must replay the complete Artifact semantic validator before construction.

artifact-native.structuralExclusion: A scoped Artifact-native extension cannot author lifecycle, host, provider, support, or conformance state.

typed-handle.structuralExclusion: Only a typed registry reference crosses the portable boundary; arbitrary evaluator values do not.

target-native.structuralExclusion: Target-native content is confined to a registered construction contract and re-enters every Packet C profile, identity, manifest, and realization check.

unsafe-opaque.structuralExclusion: Unregistered or semantically opaque extensions are rejected rather than weakening conformance.

create.structuralExclusion: Create-owned values may select or narrow only within the immutable Artifact contract.

operator.structuralExclusion: Operator configuration binds implementation and placement without reinterpreting Artifact policy.

service.structuralExclusion: Managed-service configuration compiles to the Core API and never creates second lifecycle or Artifact semantics.

live.structuralExclusion: A live operation acts only on an existing Sandbox within immutable bounds.

exec.structuralExclusion: Exec input owns one Process and can only narrow the existing Sandbox boundary.

framework.structuralExclusion: Framework and CLI adapters translate lifecycle requests and cannot author Artifact or runtime policy.

provider-admission.structuralExclusion: Provider inputs are untrusted transport or construction data and cannot redefine portable semantics.

provider-operation.structuralExclusion: Provider operations and cache results are untrusted and revalidated before driver mutation.

manifest-load.structuralExclusion: Built manifests and members are untrusted until identity, profile, and construction evidence are verified.

target-lowering.structuralExclusion: Target lowering re-derives Packet C from the validated Artifact, builds the member, independently verifies member and manifest identity, then revalidates at load.

provider-build.structuralExclusion: Provider construction and caches are untrusted optimizations whose output identity and equivalence evidence are independently verified by the product.

provider-result.structuralExclusion: A provider result has no authority until the product verifier independently checks output identity, provenance, and equivalence evidence.

operator-source.structuralExclusion: Operator Configuration source semantics can author only operator-owned configuration and cannot author Artifact, Create, Service, live, Exec, framework, or runtime facts.

managed-service-source.structuralExclusion: Managed-Service Definition source semantics can author only service-owned desired state and cannot author Artifact, Create, Operator, live, Exec, framework, or runtime facts.

resolved-driver-handoff.structuralExclusion: Only product-owned private resolved stages advance to PreparedLaunch; copied or foreign record shapes cannot enter the chain.

serialized-resolved-reentry.structuralExclusion: Serialized resolved state is wholly untrusted and cannot mint a private stage without strict decoding, exact replay, and current H0 reacquisition.

generated-runtime-configuration.structuralExclusion: Backend configuration is total D0 output from PreparedLaunch, suppresses undeclared defaults, and is validated as a closed generated value.

direct-driver-invocation.structuralExclusion: Direct driver invocation has no admitted value and is rejected before external mutation.

raw-runtime-config-input.structuralExclusion: Raw runtime configuration has no admitted value and is rejected before external mutation.
